excluded_engines.name: Viggle-Animate / MiniMax H3
excluded_engines.reason: MiniMax H3 Community License grants rights only within the Applicable Territory, which excludes the EU, UK, Republic of Korea and USA; user is in Korea. Do not download or run.

geometry.rule: resize source 1280x720 to 853x480 keeping aspect, center-crop width to 832; apply identically to source, anchor and masks

anchor.engine: Codex native imagegen (same path as C-001/C-004)

repair_sentences.G2: 두 강아지의 화면 위치를 첫 번째 이미지의 해당 강아지와 같은 자리에 두세요.
repair_sentences.G3: 래브라도의 크기를 첫 번째 이미지의 해당 강아지와 비슷하거나 조금 더 크게 해 주세요.
repair_sentences.G4: 이탈리안 그레이하운드의 크기를 첫 번째 이미지의 해당 강아지와 비슷하게 해 주세요.
repair_sentences.G5: 배경, 바닥, 조명은 첫 번째 이미지와 완전히 같게 유지해 주세요.

anchor.after_second_failure: record failed gates and proceed with second anchor, except G1 which stops (ANCHOR_UNUSABLE)

E1.name: LTX-2.3 + Union Control IC-LoRA
E1.license: LTX-2 Community License (verify actual LICENSE file); Gemma Terms of Use for text encoder
E1.prompt: Two dogs dancing in the same room: a large black Labrador Retriever and a slender grey Italian Greyhound. Keep their identities, body sizes and the original background. Stable camera.

E2.name: Bernini-R RV2V
reference_images: optional: REF_LAB, REF_IG if official case format supports multiple references
E2.instruction: Replace the two dogs in the video with the two dogs in the reference image: the large black Labrador Retriever and the slender grey Italian Greyhound, matching their positions. Keep the dance motion, timing, background, lighting and camera exactly.
E2.env_policy: isolated venv sharing existing torch (2.14+cu130 per C-012); prevent pip from installing another torch; record RUNTIME_DIFF

engines.too_slow_rule: if 49-frame extrapolation still exceeds 1.5x the engine cap, mark ENGINE_TOO_SLOW and skip

warn_and_continue: PSI full avg10 above 10% for less than 30 s (including during model load)
stop: MemAvailable below 12 GiB for 30 s or longer
PSI full avg10 above 25% for 60 s or longer
real conflict with a protected external service (e.g. queue on 8190)

reference_only_metrics: appearance embedding similarity to REF_LAB / REF_IG
evaluation.viewer: 6-column synced playback (source, anchor, E1-s1, E1-s2, E2-s1, E2-s2) + optional Kling column; casting labels on source
